topic: YZ Ceti b Radio Signal Discovery
title: The Terrifying Truth Behind the Alien Radio Signal #Shorts
facts: The detected radio signal does not actually originate from the planet itself, but is generated on the host star, triggered by the planet plowing through the star's magnetic field like a cosmic guitar pick.
The planet, despite being rocky and Earth-sized, orbits its sun so closely that a single 'year' lasts just 31 hours, forcing it to endure a constant, crushing storm of solar plasma.
The signal is the electromagnetic signature of an aurora (Northern Lights) happening on the star itself, rather than on the planet.
